stations.name: Svalbard Satellite Station (SvalSat)
stations.description: High-latitude Arctic station offering visibility on all 14 daily orbits for polar and SSO satellites.

stations.name: Goldstone Deep Space Complex
stations.description: Mojave desert primary tracking station with massive aperture dishes and low atmospheric interference.

stations.name: Madrid Deep Space Complex
stations.description: European hub for deep space and mid-inclination LEO telemetry.

stations.name: Canberra Deep Space Complex
stations.description: Southern Hemisphere anchor in the Tidbinbilla Valley.

stations.name: Kourou Ground Station (Diane)
stations.description: Equatorial tracking station adjacent to Guiana Space Centre.

stations.name: Singapore CRISP Ground Station
stations.description: Strategic equatorial station covering Southeast Asia and Malacca shipping corridors.

stations.name: TrollSat Ground Station
stations.description: Antarctic ice plateau station, complementing SvalSat for near-continuous dual-pole polar tracking.

stations.name: Fairbanks Satellite Facility
stations.description: Alaskan sub-polar station for rapid earth observation downlinks.
